message.content:
This is a Halloween costume, which is festive apparel. Costumes of this type fall in HTSUS 9505 (festive articles), though textile costumes are often classified in Chapter 61 or 62. Note 1(e) to Chapter 95 excludes fancy dress of textiles in Chapter 61 or 62. Under that exclusion, the costume would be classified as apparel.

Several CBP rulings on children's costumes with a padded bodysuit, hood, wings and mask treat them as a "set" or as a costume of textile. Many rulings say that costumes made up of a jumpsuit and a mask are classified in 9505.90.6000 when they are not wearing apparel (flimsy, novelty). The 2007 and later rulings hold that "Halloween costumes" which are not of the type of normal wearing apparel are classified in 9505. The padded bodysuit with wings and mask is a classic case, and the ruling probably classified it in 9505.90.6000.

Considering the ruling language "consists of a long-sleeved, padded bodysuit, hood, wings and a mask", the likely outcome is 9505.90.6000, which covers festive, carnival or other entertainment articles other than of plastic.
